verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official CLI for performing server-side tasks from the terminal. It covers managing projects, resources and Functions, and its non-interactive, headless mode suits automation and agent-driven workflows; it also generates type-safe SDKs and type definitions from the database schema. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, explicit agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output documented for AI agents).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Appwrite Command Line Interface (CLI) is an application that allows you to interact with Appwrite to perform server-side tasks using your terminal.
This includes creating and managing projects, managing resources (rows, files, users), creating and deploying Appwrite Functions, and other operations available through Appwrite's API.
The Appwrite CLI can be used in a non-interactive and headless manner, without saving configuration or sessions.
The generate command creates a type-safe SDK tailored to your project.
